finding.expected: Carrier acceptance must require the dispatch job result to be success. Failure, cancellation, or skip must remain observable as rejected/not accepted, must not close the Issue as successful, and must preserve a failing carrier outcome without fabricating A3, RUN, verification, review, or publication success.
finding.issue: The carrier treats any reusable-workflow result other than skipped as dispatch accepted. A failed or cancelled dispatch job therefore produces DISPATCH_ACCEPTED, closes the Issue, and does not trip the terminal fail-closed step even though the coalesced remediation workflow did not complete successfully.
